angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 653,958 km at 53.49 pc = 0.16 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 18.6967 +/- 0.0133 mas (same row, RUWE 1.05): 53.49 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.94 +/- 0.02 solar radii from Lubin et al. 2022, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 191939 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..101L/abstract): 653,958 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.81 +/- 0.04 solar masses from Lubin et al. 2022, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 191939 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..101L/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5348 +/- 100 K from Lubin et al. 2022, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 191939 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..101L/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Lubin et al. 2022, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 191939 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..101L/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hd-191939.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.400, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 191939 (pscomppars): spectral type G9 V, from Lubin et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..101L/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 191939 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.15 dex, from Lubin et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..196L/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 191939 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.18709, from Lubin et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..196L/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 191939 (pscomppars): age 8.7 Gyr, from Lubin et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..196L/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 191939 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.6 km/s, from Lubin et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..196L/abstract)
